explication: Playwright Skill equips an agent to author task-specific browser automation, runs that code through a portable Node executor, and returns execution artifacts such as screenshots and console output. Its main runtime is the executor and optional helpers; the skill instructions and API reference guide task authoring. The README documents broader automation scenarios, while source excerpts show executor dispatch and helper behavior. Unsampled skill instructions and API-reference internals are represented only at their documented paths.
